owner_type "user" requires a lowercase canonical UUID (identity.users.id / identity.sub_accounts.id), but got "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa:z". An account is never opened for an owner whose identifier space is undeclared: a bigint member id where a user UUID belongs would open a SECOND conformant account for the same human, and every invariant would still report clean (§4.2, ADR 2026-08-02).

lock pot account for user:11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 in USDT has no purpose — a hold must name its claim (e.g. "order:<id>", "trade:<id>", "token:stake:<id>") so one claim cannot spend another's reservation (P0-3 / L3-4 / L1-L3-5 / §8.1)

lock pot account for user:11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 in USDT uses forbidden purpose "legacy:x" — the legacy: prefix was a one-time migration stamp, not a claim (migration 0008 / P0-3 / L3-4 / L1-L3-5 / §8.1)
available account for house:fees:trade in USDT must not carry purpose "x" — available is fungible; only lock pots name a claim (P0-3 / §4.2)
